scope: Already audited saved internal-val predictions only; no training, inference or new scoring during publication.

units.epoch_learning_rate: scheduler value at epoch end; rate for the next update, not constant within an epoch

definitions.strict_entity_match: Start, end and entity type must all match. Python Unicode character indices; half-open [start,end).
definitions.length_group_assignment: Gold TP/FN by gold length; FP by predicted length. A boundary mismatch may assign its FN/FP to different groups.
definitions.length_group_sentences: Sentences containing at least one gold or predicted entity in this group; can differ between models. Gold support remains fixed.
definitions.small_group_flag: gold<30 or predicted<30 or involved sentences<30; even unflagged finite groups such as 52 or 72 gold require caution.
definitions.component_partition: Remove exact TP; build gold/prediction overlap bipartite graph on FN/FP; connected components give mutually exclusive geometric units.
definitions.split_merge_candidates: 1 gold to multiple predictions / multiple gold to 1 prediction within a component; geometric candidates, not confirmed semantic diagnoses.
definitions.boundary_shapes: Within 1:1 same-type boundary mismatch: predicted span contains gold=overextended; gold contains prediction=undercovered; otherwise shifted.
definitions.side_vs_component_unit: Side categories partition each FN and FP separately; do not add them to components or treat an FN+FP pair as independent causes.
definitions.type_involvement: A component can involve several types; type-involvement counts are nonexclusive and not additive to global events.
definitions.selection: Maximum strict entity micro F1 on fixed internal val, min_delta=0; earliest epoch wins ties.

baseline.combined_active_time_estimate_scope: Original manifest start-to-confirmed-stop wall + resumed fit timer; slightly different timing boundaries, excludes long pause
baseline.physical_count_limitation: Forced stop could interrupt after optimizer.step before batch log; logged count is a lower bound, retained lineage count is exact.

timing.limitation: Interrupted/resumed Baseline timing is not directly comparable to continuous dropout02 fit; no speedup claim.

unit_definitions.sentence: Exact equality of all strict entity sets; includes sentences with zero gold entities
unit_definitions.gold_entity: Fixed gold span/type recovered by neither/one/both models
unit_definitions.spurious_prediction: Exact non-gold span/type, persistent/removed/added across models
unit_definitions.same_score: Report both identical TP/FP/FN tuple and identical rational per-sentence F1; neither is an independent causal event

dialogue_cluster_bootstrap.observational_unit: whole dialogue; all its sentences kept together
dialogue_cluster_bootstrap.limitations: Exploratory conditional on these trained/selected checkpoints and this internal val; not training-seed variability or independent confirmation after validation-based epoch selection; not a universal significance claim.

unavailable.training_seed_variability: Not measured: one seed42 training per dropout setting.
unavailable.full_val_reinferred_nll: Not performed; NLL cross-checked across original saved logs/history/metrics.
unavailable.causal_semantic_error_attribution: Aggregate geometric analysis cannot establish causes or annotation errors.
unavailable.independent_official_test_performance: No official dev/test tuning or predictions used.
